channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lance Stephenson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lance Stephenson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kelly Oubre on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
“There was a play where I contested a shot and me and Lance (Stephenson) both went to the ground,”

Kelly Oubre on Lance Stephenson, Feb 1, 2022. Source: Charlotte Observer.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Lance Stephenson, Domantas Sabonis
item.description:
James Boyd:Rick Carlisle:

“Tremendous effort by our guys. ... Sabonis was spectacular. Stephenson was tremendous. ... Lance has given us a different vibe as a team. The spark he provides, the personality. ... There's a change in our team.”

Rick Carlisle on Lance Stephenson, Domantas Sabonis, Jan 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Scott Agness:Rick Carlisle on Lance Stephenson’s return:

“He’s an energetic guy. He always plays with attitude.… He’s played very well all year long in the G League. “He’ll get an opportunity with us and I know he’s gonna go at it full boar.”

Rick Carlisle on Lance Stephenson, Jan 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Marquis Teague on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Invites are exclusive, the gym is packed with pros, and there’s no telling you you might bump into on the court on any given day.

“We let them come work out with us and play guys like Yogi, Glenn Robinson, Lance Stephenson,”

Marquis Teague on Lance Stephenson, Jun 16, 2020. Source: WISH-TV.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Thunder’sRussell Westbrook on his air guitar celebration near Lakers’ Lance Stephenson:

“Was I thinking about it? I wasn’t thinking about no damn guitar. It was an and-one. Having fun, per usual.”

Russell Westbrook on Lance Stephenson, Jan 3, 2019. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Luke Walton on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Luke Walton on Lance Stephenson:

“He's been great all season. Whether he's playing or not, he's cheering, he's bringing energy. He's on the court, he's bouncing around. He's on the bench, he's yelling at his teammates.”

Luke Walton on Lance Stephenson, Oct 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
LeBron James on Lance Stephenson:

“He's never doing anything to try to alienate himself away from the team. He plays hard. Extremely hard. Guy makes mistakes, but they giving all they got 110%, you can ride w that, so I'm happy to have him.”

LeBron James on Lance Stephenson, Sep 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Ryan Ward:LeBron James on Lance Stephenson:

“I love Lance. Like I said, he'll run through a wall for any one of his teammates.”

LeBron James on Lance Stephenson, Sep 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on LeBron James, Lance Stephenson, Larry Bird
item.description:
Kevin Pritchard:

“It's always a balance, right? With Lance (Stephenson), we had a lot of conversations with his agent and with him during that time. There was a chance we were going to bring him back, but I think he got that call from LeBron or LeBron's agent. That was a powerful thing, and we don't blame him. It was misconstrued a little bit how I feel about Lance. Lance meant a lot to this organization. I kind of looked at it like this will be his home. Larry Bird drafted him, we spent a lot of time developing him, he left and then he came back … and with Lance, one of the great things is when you get to the playoffs, you need a little X-factor. And Lance was that X-factor.”

Kevin Pritchard on LeBron James, Lance Stephenson, Larry Bird, Sep 14, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
#Lakers GM Rob Pelinka on Lance Stephenson:

“It’s incredibly exciting to have Lance join our team. Lance is playoff-tested and will bring a certain edge, confidence and toughness to our roster.”

Rob Pelinka on Lance Stephenson, Jul 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Kevin Pritchard on not picking up the team option on Lance Stephenson’s contract:

“This was a very difficult decision, but as free agency begins on July 1, we want to have flexibility so that we can prepare for all of our available options.”

Kevin Pritchard on Lance Stephenson, Jun 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Larry Bird on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Nate Taylor:Larry Bird on Lance Stephenson:

“I think Lance and his agent are doing the talking... Right now probably a very slim chance”

Larry Bird on Lance Stephenson, Jul 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByNateTaylor.

item.title: Isaiah Whitehead on Lance Stephenson, Sebastian Telfair
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Isaiah Whitehead on Sebastian Telfair & Lance Stephenson:

“I talk to those guys everyday. Just about what to do, what not to do. They help me out a lot.”

Isaiah Whitehead on Lance Stephenson, Sebastian Telfair, Jun 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Paul Pierce on Lance Stephenson:

“It’s just like when I was in Boston watching the Red Sox seeing Manny be Manny, I’m watching Lance be Lance”

Paul Pierce on Lance Stephenson, Feb 2, 2016. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Doc Rivers on Stephenson trade:

“It’s a risk if you by one year, but I don’t know if it’s a risk if you go by body of work over his career.”

Doc Rivers on Lance Stephenson, Jun 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
“I like that [Stephenson] can play multiple positions -- really 2, 3 and 1 -- because he’s a terrific passer,”

Doc Rivers on Lance Stephenson, Jun 17, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Scott Agness:Vogel on Stephenson rumor:

“I'm not going to talk about anything but our team and winning tonight's game.”

Frank Vogel on Lance Stephenson, Dec 15, 2014. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Rondo on elbow to Stephenson:

“He weighs about 60 more pounds than me. I don't think I was that strong on that play to knock him down.”

Rajon Rondo on Lance Stephenson, Dec 11, 2014. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
“He's a fan of Lance. He loves his competitiveness, and he talked to him candidly about why we think he's such a good fit for our franchise and about things ... that (Stephenson) could control to get better. I thought that set the tone for the whole meeting.”

Steve Clifford on Lance Stephenson, Oct 14, 2014. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Larry Bird on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Jeff Zillgitt:Larry Bird on Lance Stephenson:

“When it comes down to it, it's up to him whether he wants to be here or not. ... I always want him back.”

Larry Bird on Lance Stephenson, Jun 2, 2014. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: Joe Johnson on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Joe Johnson on Lance Stephenson being upset with him:

“He needs to talk with the coaches, man. I ain’t got nothing to do with it.”

Joe Johnson on Lance Stephenson, Feb 2, 2014. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Scott Agness:Vogel on Stephenson:

“I think hands down, he’s the Most Improved Player in the league so far. He continues to give us a great lift.”

Frank Vogel on Lance Stephenson, Dec 23, 2013. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: LeBron James on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Stephenson apologized after that incident, and James said at the time:

“Lance Stephenson? You want a quote about Lance Stephenson? I’m not even going to give him the time.”

LeBron James on Lance Stephenson, May 23, 2013. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: LeBron James on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
James asked incredulously.

“You want a quote about Lance Stephenson? I'm not even going to give him the time.”

LeBron James on Lance Stephenson, Apr 12, 2013. Source: Grantland.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Lance Stephenson
item.description:
Shaun Powell:Frank Vogel, on Lance Stephenson choke sign:

“I want enthusiasm on the bench. I don't want gestures that go over the top.”

Frank Vogel on Lance Stephenson, May 20, 2012. Source: Twitter.
